period_note: Half-Yearly unaudited report used as the project's Q2 data point, per project-wide convention. Cumulative-from-Jan-1 convention established from the filing's own column header '01 January to 30 June 2025' (the filing also separately shows a discrete '01 April to 30 June' 3-month column, not used here to keep the series consistent); flagged via the _cumulative suffix. Standalone/Solo basis (the filing's plain 'Balance Sheet (Un-audited)' / 'Profit and Loss Account (Un-audited)', distinct from its separately-presented 'Consolidated' statements). Source PDF (half_yearly_report_2025.pdf) is a scanned/OCR document; pdftotext extracted 0 lines (no usable text layer at all). All figures below were sourced via direct visual inspection of 400dpi page renders of the standalone Balance Sheet (source page 8) and Profit and Loss Account (source page 9), both independently verified fully internally consistent (balance sheet ties to the taka: Total Liabilities 344,756,150,032 + Total Equity 25,698,176,135 = Total Assets 370,454,326,167; equity roll-forward of each reserve line sums exactly to Total Shareholders' Equity for both the current and comparative column; Profit before tax 2,651,965,010 - Provision for tax 1,500,377,551 = Net Profit after tax 1,151,587,459). RESTATEMENT FOUND (same pattern as Q1 2025): the FY2026 H1 report's comparative column for this same period (Jan-Jun 2025), explicitly labeled by the bank as '[previous period's figure restated]' on the deferred-tax line, shows a deferred tax figure of BDT (946.15)mn (vs BDT +44.85mn reported contemporaneously here), producing a much higher restated PAT of BDT 2,142.59mn and EPS of 1.86, versus the BDT 1,151.59mn / EPS 1.04 reported in this (earlier, contemporaneous) filing; the Profit-before-tax line itself is identical in both sources (BDT 2,651.97mn), isolating the restatement entirely to the deferred-tax treatment. Per project convention, this contemporaneous figure is retained and the later restatement is NOT adopted; the 2026_Q2.json file's period_note also documents this divergence from its own side. CROSS-CHECK DISCREPANCY: this filing's own comparative 'as at 31 December 2024' balance-sheet column shows Total Assets BDT 346,956.97mn and Total Shareholders' Equity BDT 24,700.46mn, which diverge from the existing bank_financials/NCCBANK/quarterly/2024_Q4.json figures (Total Assets BDT 348,206mn, Total Equity BDT 26,871mn; sourced from the FY2025 Annual Report's 'Five Years Performance At a Glance' table) by approximately 0.36% and 8.1% respectively. The identical 31-Dec-2024 comparative figures independently recur in the 2025_Q1 filing, confirming this is a genuine, reproducible cross-report inconsistency between NCC's own interim filings and its later annual-report summary table -- not a one-off transcription artifact. The existing 2024_Q4.json file was NOT modified.
